page_note: Page narrates the First Man's five mysteries (signs) of descent and ascent — laying-on-of-hands, peace, right hand, embrace, worship — given by Mother of Life, Father of Life, Living Spirit, summoning. Strong substrate enumeration. Two clear editorial seams: after the cosmic right-hand mystery (segs 22-24) and after the cosmic embrace mystery (segs 28-31), the editor adds etiological glosses connecting the cosmic gesture to contemporary human ritual practice (handshake, embrace among travelers). The fatigue score (+6.9 ecclesial drift) confirms editorial extension in second half. Cosmic narrative resumes with the worship mystery at seg 32.
